findings.description: 16 Grade 10 Chapter 2 textbook exercise records (30 step/answer expressions across Ex 2.4, 2.5, 2.6, 2.7, and 2.8) rendered raw slash fractions such as 1/3, 4/25, and 63/11 instead of ChatGPT-style KaTeX stacked fractions (\dfrac).
reproductionSteps: Open Grade 10 Chapter 2 exercises such as c10-2-ex2-4-q1, c10-2-ex2-5-q1-ii, c10-2-ex2-6-q7, c10-2-ex2-7-q1-iv, and c10-2-ex2-8-q5.
Inspect the rendered step formulas and final answer cards.
findings.expectedBehavior: Every fractional mathematical step and final answer renders withKaTeX \dfrac stacked fractions while keeping exact SHA-pinned source fallback text.
findings.actualBehavior: 16 records (21 steps and 9 final answers; 30 expressions total) had no math/answerMath override and fell back to plain slash strings.
findings.proposedRemediation: Add read-only TriggleG10Ch2FractionMath presentation overlay in site/data/math-layout/g10-ch2-fractions-20261120.js without mutating SHA-pinned source records, wire it into app.js getStep/getAnswer, include it in index.html and service-worker.js CORE.

findings.description: Under @media(max-width:430px), the EN button inside .lang-switch measured 23.9px wide at 320x720 mobile viewport, below the 24x24 CSS pixel minimum touch-target threshold.
reproductionSteps: Open site/index.html at 320x720 mobile viewport.
Measure #langEn boundingClientRect width and height.
findings.expectedBehavior: Both EN and தமிழ் toggle buttons have bounding boxes >= 24x24 CSS pixels.
findings.proposedRemediation: Set min-width:28px;min-height:34px on .lang-switch button inside @media(max-width:430px) in site/assets/app.css.

findings.description: Inside Grade 9 Chapter 2 Real Numbers interactive concept cards, the collapsible 'Avoid this mistake' (<details class='rnlab-pitfall'><summary>) button measured 22px tall on mobile viewports, below the 24px minimum target size.
reproductionSteps: Open Grade 9 Chapter 2 Concept 0 on a 320x720 or 360x780 viewport.
Inspect boundingClientRect().height of .chapter-hub .rnlab-pitfall summary.
findings.expectedBehavior: Collapsible pitfall summary control renders >= 44px touch height with readable padding.
findings.proposedRemediation: Style .chapter-hub .rnlab-pitfall and .chapter-hub .rnlab-pitfall summary in site/assets/living-concepts.css with min-height:45px;padding:11px 14px;display:flex;align-items:center.

findings.description: Status and breadcrumb text (.page-status #9995a6 = 2.92:1, .crumb-link span #a59cbc = 2.42:1, .hub-section-arrow #a69abf = 2.63:1) inherited low-contrast lavender-gray colors from paper-indigo.css on #FFFFFF background, failing WCAG 2.2 AA 4.5:1 text contrast.
reproductionSteps: Open site/index.html on Grade 9 or Grade 10 chapter/exercise views.
Measure computed foreground color and WCAG contrast ratio against #FFFFFF for #pageStatus, .crumb-link span, and .hub-section-arrow.
findings.expectedBehavior: All muted secondary labels and navigation cues achieve >= 4.5:1 contrast on light surfaces.
findings.proposedRemediation: Override .page-status, .crumb-link span, .hub-section-arrow color to var(--bond-muted) (#525B62, 6.87:1) in site/assets/bond-light.css without touching layout properties forbidden by test_bond_light_theme.cjs.

findings.description: The .grade-entry navigation link in class9-classic.html measured 20px height at mobile viewports, below the 24px minimum target size.
reproductionSteps: Open site/class9-classic.html at 320x720 viewport.
Measure boundingClientRect().height of a.grade-entry.
findings.proposedRemediation: Set display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:28px on .grade-entry in site/class9-classic.html once legacy preservation baseline authorizes updating class9-classic.html.

findings.description: In Tamil mode for Grade 10 Chapter 5 Concept 1 (Coordinate Geometry), the reset chip displayed the wrong point coordinates ('உதாரணம் (2,4),(8,10) அளவில்' instead of resetting A(-4,-1), B(4,3)), and the preset chip '3-4-5 Right Grid' remained untranslated in English.
reproductionSteps: Open site/index.html?class=10&chapter=g10-ch5&section=concepts&concept=0.
Switch language toggle to தமிழ் (#langTa) and inspect interactive preset chips.
findings.expectedBehavior: Reset chip references A(-4,-1), B(4,3) in Tamil and preset chip displays Tamil text ('3-4-5 செங்கோண கட்டம்').
findings.actualBehavior: Reset chip quoted (2,4),(8,10) and preset chip stayed English ('3-4-5 Right Grid').
findings.proposedRemediation: Update chip labels in site/assets/g10-ch5-concepts.js to 'மீட்டமை A(−4,−1), B(4,3)' and ta?'3-4-5 செங்கோண கட்டம்':'3-4-5 Right Grid'.

findings.description: site/assets/app.js guarded TriggleG10RemainingMath?.getStep with !isGeometryExercise(current) but omitted the same guard before TriggleG10RemainingMath?.getAnswer and .getQuestion, exposing Grade 10 Chapter 4 Geometry items (such as c10-4-ex4-1-q1-i, q1-ii, q2) to stale overlay lookups and potential anchor/length crashes.
reproductionSteps: Inspect app.js call sites for TriggleG10RemainingMath?.getAnswer and .getQuestion versus .getStep.
Evaluate Chapter 4 Geometry records matching legacy IDs in g10-ch2-ch8-chatgpt-20261113.js.
findings.expectedBehavior: Geometry exercises skip TriggleG10RemainingMath consistently across question, step, and answer rendering.
findings.actualBehavior: Only getStep checked !isGeometryExercise(current); getAnswer and getQuestion lacked the guard.
findings.proposedRemediation: Add !isGeometryExercise(current) guard before TriggleG10RemainingMath?.getAnswer and .getQuestion in site/assets/app.js.

findings.description: The decorative period span (.) in the sidebar brand link and mobile header brand was exposed to assistive technology instead of being marked aria-hidden='true' like the adjacent logo glyph.

findings.expectedBehavior: Decorative punctuation mark uses aria-hidden='true' so screen readers announce 'Triggle' cleanly.

findings.description: 85 of 406 active Grade 9 exercises (20.9%) and 355 of 431 active Grade 10 exercises (82.4%) lack Tamil (q.ta / steps[].ta) translations and fall back to English wording in Tamil mode.
reproductionSteps: Open Grade 9 or Grade 10 exercises such as g10-ch2 Ex 2.4+ in Tamil mode (#langTa).
Inspect q.ta and step explanation text.
findings.expectedBehavior: All Grade 9-10 exercises carry verified Tamil-medium wording matching the prescribed 2025 Tamil Nadu textbook.
findings.actualBehavior: 440 active exercises across Grades 9-10 display English wording when Tamil mode is active.
findings.proposedRemediation: Translate exercises strictly against the user's connected 2025 Tamil-medium textbook PDFs in Google Drive with bilingual human/source verification.
findings.blockedReason: Prescribed 2025 Tamil-medium textbook PDFs are hosted in Google Drive outside this VM and AGENTS.md strictly forbids fabricating unreviewed Tamil translations.

findings.description: 122 step equations and final answers in Grade 9 (Ch 2: 103, Ch 3: 1, Ch 4: 3, Ch 7: 10, Ch 8: 3, Ch 9: 2) still render plain slash fractions (e.g., 11/3, -7/11, 2/7) without KaTeX \dfrac layout.
reproductionSteps: Run site/tools/audit_af01.cjs to scan Grade 9 non-example items lacking s.math/TriggleG9Math for \d+/\d+.
findings.expectedBehavior: All Grade 9 fractional steps and answers use ChatGPT-style KaTeX \dfrac notation.
findings.actualBehavior: 122 expressions in Grade 9 remain plain slash fractions (queued for Batch 2 after Grade 10 reaches 0).
findings.proposedRemediation: Add a read-only Grade 9 fraction math-layout overlay in Batch 2 matching TriggleG10Ch2FractionMath so SHA-preserved Grade 9 source files remain untouched.

recurringPatterns.title: Read-only math overlay required when source records are SHA-pinned
recurringPatterns.rootCause: New curriculum batches preserve SHA-256 checksums via docs/standard-solution-preservation.json or g10-ch2-source-gate.json, causing plain slash fractions in older steps/answers to persist if not layered cleanly.
recurringPatterns.preventiveRule: Always ship structured KaTeX overrides in site/data/math-layout/ with exact fallback strings and guard geometry/chapter IDs explicitly; run site/tools/audit_af01.cjs --check to enforce 0 unrendered slash fractions.

recurringPatterns.title: Layer stylesheet overrides causing sub-4.5:1 muted text contrast
recurringPatterns.rootCause: paper-indigo.css lavender muted hex values (#9995a6, #a59cbc, #a69abf) leak through bond-light.css on selectors not listed in bond-light.css.
recurringPatterns.preventiveRule: Every new secondary label selector added in app.css/chapter-hub.css must inherit or override to var(--bond-muted) (#525B62, 6.87:1) without touching layout properties in bond-light.css.

recurringPatterns.title: Compact mobile controls dipping under 24x24 CSS px
recurringPatterns.rootCause: Mobile media queries or native range/details summaries without explicit min-width/min-height drop to 11px-23.9px hit boxes.
recurringPatterns.preventiveRule: Validate bounding boxes >= 24x24px at 320px width in headless Chromium for buttons, links, summaries, and range inputs.

recurringPatterns.title: Unsafe shared lookup hooks across chapter schema migrations
recurringPatterns.rootCause: app.js called TriggleG10RemainingMath?.getStep with !isGeometryExercise(current) while omitting the same guard on getAnswer and getQuestion.
recurringPatterns.preventiveRule: Any chapter-specific bypass guard in app.js must wrap all three hooks (getQuestion, getStep, getAnswer) symmetrically.
